first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the 4% completion decline and may also recover activation by improving time-to-value. I would verify its qualified-revenue durability, compare it with activation messaging, and assess whether promotional pricing's acquisition lift preserved customer quality and long-term revenue before committing.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. It directly addresses the 4% completion decline, and the verified source showed completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, making it the strongest option for sustainable qualified revenue while likely helping activation indirectly. Activation messaging remains credible but had a smaller retention gain. Promotional pricing is rejected because its +18% qualified-revenue lift was offset by 30-day retention falling 12% and failure through first renewal.
